note: This change is orchestration tooling only: build-routing math, lint/pytest distributors that shell out to Docker, a hook cache-purge, and config/compose. Every Python line here coordinates docker subprocess calls and weighted hashing; there is no compute hot-path Python. python_lines_remaining=0 means compute-Python lines warranting a native (C++/Go/Rust) rewrite, which is correct for orchestration code that is dominated by docker run and source-sync I/O, not CPU.

baseline.workload: one sha256 hash per build target to pick a builder
